sources.title: Datum Atlas compilation of typical property ranges for generic materials
sources.author: Datum Atlas contributors
sources.note: Our own compilation of typical ranges for generic grades, written from general engineering handbooks and textbooks. Draft: each value is still to be referenced to a specific table, standard or datasheet.

sources.title: Datum Atlas estimate of bulk material prices, 2024–2025
sources.author: Datum Atlas contributors
sources.note: Indicative prices in US dollars per kilogram for stock material (sheet, bar, pellets or blocks) bought in bulk. Real prices depend on form, quantity, region and date.

sources.title: MIL-HDBK-5J: Metallic Materials and Elements for Aerospace Vehicle Structures
sources.author: U.S. Department of Defense
sources.note: Design allowables for aerospace alloys (superseded by the MMPDS series). Values here are typical ranges around the handbook data, not design allowables.

sources.title: MIL-HDBK-17: Composite Materials Handbook, Volumes 2 and 3 (Polymer Matrix Composites)
sources.author: U.S. Department of Defense
sources.note: Properties and design guidance for fibre composites (continued as CMH-17). Values here are typical ranges for generic laminates.
